column2: Paano mag-filter ng groups na may higit sa 5 orders?
column4: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

column2: Paano mag-filter ng groups base sa total amount?
column4: SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(amount) > 1000;

column2: Paano mag-filter ng groups base sa average?
column4: SELECT category, AVG(price) FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING AVG(price) > 50;

column2: Paano i-combine ang WHERE at HAVING?
column4: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;

column2: Paano mag-filter ng groups na may 2 o higit pang items?
column4: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
